Class MassiWuPeppeController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.gc49.server.controller.MassiWuPeppeController
All Implemented Interfaces:
VirtualGameClient, Serializable, Remote
public class MassiWuPeppeController extends Object implements VirtualGameClient, Serializable
One controller per player. Bridges the player's network proxy and the shared Game: incoming commands from the client are dispatched to the model via executeCommand(CommandPacket), and model updates flow back through the VirtualGameClient callbacks.

If sending a packet to the client fails, the player is marked as disconnected.
